# ADR NNN — <decision title>

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD · **Context(s):** <owning context(s)>

## Context

The forces that make a decision necessary: what the system must do, what it cannot assume,
and what constraints are real. Enough for a reader who was not there.

## Decision

The decision, in one or two sentences, in the active voice: "We will …".

## Why

The reasoning. Name the trade-off explicitly; if there was no real alternative, this is not an
ADR.

## Alternatives considered

The genuine options and why each was rejected. Omit if there was only one serious contender
and saying so adds nothing.

## Consequences

What becomes easier, what becomes harder, and what future changes this constrains. Include the
obligations the decision places on later work.
